intro: I am a self-taught musician, everything I do is by ear. Keys came first since I was about 9 years old, then drums, bass, harmonica, melodica and I also love to sing! Check out examples of my work below.
awardsText: In September 2022 I took part in the London 48hr Film Challenge, joining a team as their composer. Together our short film 'Eat The Rich' won the People's Choice award, awarded by votes from the other participating teams.
